args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary (Tamarack)
args.body:
- Pick rates went up 18% with autonomous carts in warehouse automation deployments in 2026.
- Integration took about twice as long as planned, so expect longer rollout timelines.
- According to the companion piece, the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion
